更新内容
• 新增 WebDAV 音乐来源：在「音乐来源」页连接 NAS、OpenList 等 WebDAV 服务，用目录树勾选远端音乐文件夹，只读同步进曲库后与本地音乐统一浏览、收藏、管理歌单与播放统计；音乐库可按来源筛选，歌曲列表显示来源图标，同名专辑按来源区分，远端文件不会被修改
• 远程歌曲流式播放：边下边播，支持暂停、拖动定位与上下曲切换，播放栏显示网络播放状态；远端 DSF/DFF 按输出设置以 DoP/Native DSD 位流输出并自动回退兼容模式，大文件跳转任意位置无需等待整曲下载
• 修复连续切歌时封面与 WinRT 资源持续累积导致的内存增长
• 修复本地 FLAC 文件末尾数据错误导致播放停住、不自动切歌与定位失效的问题
• 修复短曲目偶发播放结束后不自动切歌的问题
• 卷积曲线预设改存「文档\OriginalSoundPlayer\Settings」目录，卸载重装或重新部署后不再丢失
• 精简设置页：移除 Atmos/5.1 状态提示中与功能开关重复的「恢复普通播放」按钮
en:
Release Notes
• New WebDAV music sources: connect to a NAS, OpenList, or any WebDAV server from the Music Sources page, check remote music folders in a directory tree, and sync them into the library read-only — remote and local music browse, favorite, playlist, and count play statistics together; filter the library by source with source icons in song lists, identically named albums stay separate per source, and remote files are never modified
• Streaming playback for remote tracks: play while downloading with pause, seeking, and previous/next switching, plus a network status indicator in the play bar; remote DSF/DFF follows your output settings as DoP/Native DSD bitstream with automatic fallback to a compatible mode, and jumping anywhere in a large file never waits for a full download
• Fixed covers and WinRT resources accumulating on repeated track switches and the resulting memory growth
• Fixed local FLAC files with corrupted trailing data stalling playback, breaking auto-advance and seeking
• Fixed short tracks occasionally not auto-advancing after they ended
• Convolution curve presets now live in the Documents\OriginalSoundPlayer\Settings folder and survive uninstall/reinstall and redeployment
• Settings cleanup: removed the redundant resume-normal-playback button from the Atmos/5.1 status banners; use the feature toggle itself
